def process_template(template_xml, user_data):
    parser = ET.XMLParser(no_network=True, resolve_entities=False)
    parser.set_feature(ET.XMLParser.Feature.EXTERNAL_DTD_LOAD, False)
    parser.set_feature(ET.XMLParser.Feature.EXTERNAL_GENERAL_ENTITIES, False)
    xml_content = template_xml.format(username=user_data)

        return "Processed document for " + root.attrib.get("user", "unknown")
